descriptions.zh: 你们非法入侵了我们，然后现在又一口一声朋友？呸！我们[contact_empire.GetName]会对你们种族保持警惕的。
descriptions.en: You hacked into us, and now you call us friend? Bah! The [contact_empire.GetName] will remain vigilant towards your kind.

descriptions.zh: 我们的处理器记录了你们网络的非法入侵企图。我们已经升级了防火墙提高我们未来应对威胁的能力。[contact_empire.GetGovernmentName]将会对名为“[Root.GetName]”的组织实体保持警惕。
descriptions.en: Our processors record unauthorized intrusion attempts from your networks. We have upgraded our firewalls to increase our security against any future threats. The [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] will remain vigilant towards the organized entity designation "[Root.GetName]".

descriptions.zh: 别对你们试图盗窃我们信息的行为掩耳盗铃，[Root.GetSpeciesName]，[contact_empire.GetGovernmentName]都知道了！我们投入了一部分意识以留意你们未来的不当举措。
descriptions.en: Do not believe your attempt to steal our data went unnoticed, [Root.GetSpeciesName] - the [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] sees all! We have dedicated a portion of our consciousness to watching for your future misdeeds.

descriptions.zh: 你们的敌意明目张胆，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]希望你们清楚，我们不会屈服于你们的威胁恐吓的。
descriptions.en: Your show of hostility is very concerning, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Our [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] wishes to let it be known that we will not bow to your threats or intimidation.

descriptions.zh: 这么恶意干嘛，[Root.GetSpeciesName]？我们对你们没有威胁！
descriptions.en: Why such hostility, [Root.GetSpeciesName]? We mean you no harm!

descriptions.zh:
探测到敌意三级智慧文明，命名为“[Root.GetName]”。

启用防御协议，海军无人机正在前往。在为时已晚之前，请停止你的敌对行为。如果拒不改变航向，我方就只能歼灭你们了。
descriptions.en:
Hostile sapient Class-3 civilization detected, designation "[Root.GetName]".

Defensive protocols enabled; naval drones scrambled. Desist from your hostility, before it is too late. Failing a change of course, we will have to schedule your elimination...

descriptions.zh: 我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，在此作为一个整体向你对话。蜂巢思维已经注意到了你之前的敌意行为。因此我们已经将你标识为威胁。如果你仍要表现得像是敌人的话，我们就只能将你从眼前彻底移除了。
descriptions.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we speak as one. The Hive Mind has noted the hostility of your past actions. We have therefore designated you as a threat. Should you not cease to act as our enemy, we will have to eliminate you from our calculations...

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你敌对的表现很让我们担忧。我们只能认为你们这些疯[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]迫不及待地想被我们高贵的[contact_empire.GetSpeciesName]击败了。
descriptions.en: Your show of hostility is very concerning, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We can only assume that you are crazed [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] in need of being put down by the superior [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName].

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]看着你们，我们的星球众口如一。你们的敌意态度令人担忧，因此我们将你们视为了威胁。记着：我们能宽容，但不会有一丝的软弱。如果你们不知悬崖勒马，我们会毫不犹豫地出手。
descriptions.en: The [contact_empire.GetName] sees you, and our worlds speak as one. Your hostile stance concerns us, and therefore we have designated you as a threat. Know this: we are capable of forgiveness, but it is not in our nature to cower. Should you continue to pose as our enemy, we shall not hesitate to strike.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，我方认为你们物种对于我们是一个极大的威胁。除非我们能确信你们对我方没有威胁，不然之前的攻击就只是我们文明之间敌对接触的开胃菜罢了。
descriptions.en: We consider your species a grave menace to our kind, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Unless you can demonstrate that you are no threat to us, our past attacks will be just the start of hostilities between our civilization.

descriptions.zh: 我们的威胁检测算法已计算出你们文明对[Root.GetName]造成的风险是不可接受的。如果你们造成的威胁无法降低，我们将自行对你们进行清除。
descriptions.en: Our threat detection algorithms have calculated the risk of your civilization causing harm to the [Root.GetName] to be intolerable. If the threat you pose cannot be otherwise mitigated, we will have to eliminate you.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们的存在对[contact_empire.GetGestaltEntityName]构成了严重的威胁。我们已经着手制定应急措施来消除你们造成的风险。如果这还不起效，必将有更进一步的措施。
descriptions.en: Your kind represents a grave threat to the [contact_empire.GetGestaltEntityName], [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We have already begun forming contingencies to mitigate the risk you pose. Should this prove insufficient, further action will be necessary.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，在为惨死在你们手术台上的[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]报仇雪恨之前，我们绝不会停下脚步！
descriptions.en: We will not rest until we have avenged the [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who found their deaths on your operating table, [Root.GetSpeciesName]!

descriptions.zh: 我们期望你们没有敌意，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但也请明白我们不会爽快地接受我们的同胞被摁在你们的手术台上进行无法形容的残酷暴行。你们已经招致我们永久的唾弃，不要再试探我们的底线了！
descriptions.en: We wish you no harm, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but know that we do not look kindly upon our kind being subjected to unspeakable atrocities on your operating tables. You have already earned our eternal displeasure - do not push us further!

descriptions.zh: 你们为什么拆解我们，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们的这些单位并没有出故障。
descriptions.en: Why do you dismantle us, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Our units were not defective.

descriptions.zh: 对[contact_empire.GetName]而言几个子个体不是什么巨大的损失，但是你们诉诸暴力的准备已经昭然若揭。我们不会再容忍你们继续做出这样的行为了。
descriptions.en: The loss of our drones is no great loss to the [contact_empire.GetName], but the readiness of your species to resort to violence has been noted. We will not tolerate any further actions of this kind.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经了解了可观的关于你们内在解剖结构运作的数据，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。可以说，我们对你们了如指掌了。
descriptions.en: We have gathered considerable data on the inner workings of your anatomy, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One might even say we know you... inside-out.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经了解了可观的关于你们内部电路和处理器运作的数据，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。可以说，我们对你们了如指掌了。
descriptions.en: We have gathered considerable data on the inner workings of your circuitry and processors, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One might even say we know you... inside-out.

descriptions.zh: 我们并非鱼肉，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。作为[contact_empire.GetName]的代表，我正式向你们提出警告，将来你们任何的侵犯将会招致我们的全力打击。
descriptions.en: We are not your food, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As a representative of the [contact_empire.GetName], I am authorized to warn you that any future transgressions will be met by the full force of our arms.

descriptions.zh: 我们并非鱼肉，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]倡导和平，但我们在必须保卫自己的时候绝不手软。
descriptions.en: We are not your food, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] lead a peaceful way of life, but we will not hesitate to defend ourselves should it become necessary.

descriptions.zh: 你们为什么拆解我们，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们的这些单位并没有出故障。
descriptions.en: Why do you dismantle us, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Our units were not defective.

descriptions.zh: 我们建议你们死了这条心，摸摸自己的[Root.GetSpeciesToothNamePlural]看看能不能吃得动我们，[Root.GetSpeciesName]！告诉你们，我们[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会向你们抗争直至最后一颗卵石为止也不屈服。
descriptions.en: We hope you broke your [Root.GetSpeciesToothNamePlural] in your vain attempt to eat us, [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Know that we [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] remain unbowed and will resist your kind to the last pebble.

descriptions.zh: 进食我们的子个体是一种浪费，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。它们不是以此为目的设计出来的，我们强烈要求你们停止这种行为。
descriptions.en: It is a waste to eat our drones, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. They were not made for that purpose, and we must firmly request that you desist.

descriptions.zh: 你们看起来很好吃，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。很快你们将荣升为我们子个体的主食之一。
descriptions.en: You were delicious, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon, you will become part of our drones' staple diet.

descriptions.zh: 将你们的无人机拆解重溶后得到的材料极具价值。我们预期，我们的铸造厂里很快就会堆满[Root.GetAdj]的零件。
descriptions.en: The raw materials we melted your drones down to were most valuable. We anticipate that our forges will soon be filled with [Root.GetAdj] scrap metal.

descriptions.zh: 你们的敌意不过是将你们从这个星系里铲除的又一个理由，外星渣滓。
descriptions.en: Your hostility is just one more reason why your kind need to be removed from the face of the galaxy, xeno scum.

descriptions.zh:
侦测到有机害虫。

TargetList.SwapToTailAndRemoveFromGalaxy( "[Root.GetName]" );
descriptions.en:
Hostile organic vermin detected.

TargetList.SwapToTailAndRemoveFromGalaxy( "[Root.GetName]" );

descriptions.zh: 为什么攻击我们，名称为“[Root.GetName]”的？你们不在目标列表上。
descriptions.en: Why do you attack us, designation "[Root.GetName]"? You are not on the target list.

descriptions.zh: 你们大可以放马过来，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但挣扎是徒劳的：你们还是我们的猎物。
descriptions.en: You are right to attack us, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but that will not save you: you are still our prey.

descriptions.zh: 你们的敌意令人感到不幸。我们曾考虑过像[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一样宽恕你们，但看起来你们至少需要……重新接受教育。
descriptions.en: Your hostility is unfortunate. We had considered sparing you, being fellow [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] as you are, but it seems you will need to be... re-educated, at the very least.

descriptions.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]无可争议的指挥官——[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]带来问候。不要将我们的流浪误认为软弱，我们的舰队已经击碎过许多犯下此种错误的敌人。让你们的飞船离我们的编队远点，或许这样我们的战士们就没理由向你们展示他们的战斗决心了。
descriptions.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed commander of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Do not mistake our wandering for weakness, our fleets have broken many who made that error. Keep your ships well clear of our formation, and perhaps our warriors will have no cause to demonstrate their resolve.

descriptions.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]无可争议的统治者——[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]送上问候。尊重我们的领地并避免干涉我们的事务，或许我们可以考虑让我们战无不胜的舰队绕开你们的世界。
descriptions.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed ruler of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Respect our borders and keep out of our affairs, and perhaps our mighty fleets will refrain from visiting your worlds.

descriptions.zh: 很高兴见到你。我谨代表由卓越的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]所领导的[contact_empire.GetName]。我们在神圣的指引下巡游星辰，这趟神圣漫游是由超越凡人理解的力量所命定的。只要你们不干涉我们的精神事务就能保持友好相处。
descriptions.en: Well met. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We journey the stars under divine guidance, our sacred wandering ordained by powers beyond mortal understanding. So long as you do not interfere in our spiritual affairs, our relations may remain cordial.

descriptions.zh: 您好，我谨代表在[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]统治下的[contact_empire.GetName]向您致以问候。我们遵照神灵的旨意治理着属于我们的领地。只要您不干涉我们的宗教事务，我们将一直保持真挚的友谊关系。
descriptions.en: Well met. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We rule our region of space under a divine mandate, and so long as you do not interfere in our spiritual affairs, our relations may remain cordial.

descriptions.zh: 我们来自[contact_empire.GetName]，是伟大智者[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]的仆人。我们希望通过科技提高自身，无论你对此是否赞同，我们都相信您会是一位友邻。
descriptions.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], minions of the wise [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Our aim is to improve ourselves through the use of technology, and whether you agree with these goals or not, we trust you will remain amicable neighbors.

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]致以问候。我们是一个崇尚和平的国度，由我们敬爱的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]公正地治理着。无论我们两国将来发生什么冲突，我们都希望能通过交流谈判解决，而非诉诸暴力。
descriptions.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a peaceful nation, justly ruled by our beloved [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Whatever grievances might arise between our people in the future, we hope they can be settled through dialogue rather than violence.

descriptions.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]在此发言，并向贵方表示问候。只要你们不干涉我国内政并对我们伟大的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]保持敬畏，我们两国的关系便没有理由恶化。
descriptions.en: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName], and I have been authorized to bring you greetings. As long as you stay out of our internal affairs and treat our great leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] with reverence, I see no reason for our diplomatic relations to sour.

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]执政委员会发来问候。我方希望与贵方人民建立富有成效的关系。但我们郑重警告，任何冒犯我方领地的行为都将得到最严厉的回应。
descriptions.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] sends regards from the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We hope for a productive relationship with your people, but be warned that our military will respond to any transgressions near our space with maximum force.

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]以及宗教委员会的其他成员向您致以问候。我们为[contact_empire.GetName]提供精神指导，我们带领着这个伟大的国家走在救赎之路上。不要干涉我们的道路，这样我们的友谊就会长存。
descriptions.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the rest of the religious council bids you greetings. We provide spiritual guidance to the [contact_empire.GetName] and our stated goal is to lead this great nation on a path to salvation. Do not cross this path and we may live in friendship.

descriptions.zh: 您好。我由[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]选中，代表[contact_empire.GetName]与贵国进行交流。我方致力于发掘科技的全部潜力，在贵国不干涉我方追求知识的前提下，我们可以和谐共处。
descriptions.en: Greetings. I have been chosen by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] to represent the [contact_empire.GetName] in all diplomatic dealings with your people. We strive to unlock the full potential of technology, and you would do well not to interfere with our pursuit of knowledge.

descriptions.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]向贵方致以最为诚挚的问候。我方建立了一套和平的行政系统，在[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]领导的议会监管下运作。希望我们两国友谊长存。
descriptions.en: I am authorized to offer you cordial greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have built a peaceful system of government that operates under the supervision of a council led by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. May our two nations know nothing but peace.

descriptions.zh: 您好。我谨代表[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]，以及[contact_empire.GetName]的精英们向您致以问候。我们一直在寻求新的贸易伙伴，希望日后我们可以达成利于两国商业发展的协定。
descriptions.en: Greetings. I speak for [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the wealthy elite of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are always looking for new trading partners, and hopefully we can come to some sort of accommodation that will benefit the commerce of both our nations.

descriptions.zh: 本人在此代表[contact_empire.GetName]。我们的民选领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]希望与贵方和平共处，但是我们也拥有足够的力量来保卫我们的生活方式。
descriptions.en: I represent the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our elected leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] hopes for peaceful relations with your people, but know that we are more than capable of defending our way of life.

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]是[contact_empire.GetName]的人民选举出的领袖，我带来他真挚的问候。我们相信所有智慧生物都拥有满足其精神需求的权利，希望贵方也持同样的观点。
descriptions.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the elected leader of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and we hope you share in this sentiment.

descriptions.zh: 这是来自[contact_empire.GetName]的问候。[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]虽是我们选出的代表，但事实上所有公民对于国家事务都有发言权。我们努力通过发展技术以完善自身，希望贵方能够尊重我们的意愿。
descriptions.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology, a desire we hope you will respect.

descriptions.zh: 很高兴见到你们，朋友们。我们[contact_empire.GetName]是建立在和平共处与个人自由原则之上的国家。当前的政府领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]真切地希望我们两国的人民能够友谊长存。
descriptions.en: Well met, friends. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful coexistence and individual freedoms. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government, has expressed a sincere hope for a lasting friendship between our two peoples.

descriptions.zh: 来自[contact_empire.GetName]的问候。我们是一个致力于维护公民个人自由的民主国家。我们的民选领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]希望与贵方人民一道建立长久而富有成果的外交关系。
descriptions.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], hopes for a long and productive relationship with your people.

descriptions.zh: 外星生物，我代表[contact_empire.GetName]无可争议的统帅[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]发言。不要把我们的游荡误认为软弱，过去有无数犯下此等错误的人，而故地只剩我们舰队离开后剩下的断壁残垣。让你们的族人离我们的编队远点，或许这样，我们的战士就没理由去拜访你们那可怜的星球了。
descriptions.en: Alien beings, I speak on behalf of [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed commander of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Do not mistake our wandering for weakness, our fleets have left wreckage in the wake of many who made that mistake. Keep your kind well clear of our formation, and perhaps our warriors will find no cause to visit your wretched worlds.

descriptions.zh: 外星生物，我代表[contact_empire.GetName]无可争议的统治者[contact_empire.GetRulerName][contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]。尊重我方边界并且不要试图插手[contact_empire.GetSpeciesName]的内政，那样我们强大的舰队也许就不会造访你们那些可怜的星球。
descriptions.en: Alien beings, I speak on behalf of [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed ruler of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Respect our borders and keep out of [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] affairs, and perhaps our mighty fleets will refrain from visiting your wretched worlds.

descriptions.zh: 外星人，留意此信息。我乃伟大的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]座下[contact_empire.GetName]的代表。在星海中远征是我们神圣的使命，而你们这种生物不过是沿途必须经受的考验。只要你们不在你们所谓的文化里侮辱我方信仰，或许我们之间会有和平可言。
descriptions.en: Heed this message, alien. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We journey the stars under a divine mandate, and your kind are a trial to be endured along the way. Do not mock our faith in what passes for your culture, and there may yet be peace between us.

descriptions.zh: 外星人，留意此信息。我乃伟大的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]座下[contact_empire.GetName]的代表。统治我方星区是我们神圣的使命，只要你们不在你们所谓的文化里侮辱我方信仰，或许我们之间会有和平可言。
descriptions.en: Heed this message, aliens. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We rule our region of space under a divine mandate, and so long as you do not mock our faith in what passes for your culture, there may be peace between us.

descriptions.zh: 我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，伟大且睿智的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]的仆人。我们的目标是通过技术提升自己。无论你方是否认同我们的理念，不要试图挑战我们，外星人。
descriptions.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], minions of the wise [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Our aim is to improve ourselves through the use of technology. Whether you agree with these goals or not, do not think to challenge us, alien.

descriptions.zh: 我们[contact_empire.GetName]是由敬爱的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]公正领导下的爱好和平的帝国。虽然我不知道你们这样的奇怪物种有多么粗鲁野蛮，但我们仍希望在未来两国间的分歧冲突可以通过对话而非暴力来解决。
descriptions.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a peaceful nation ruled justly by our beloved [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. I do not know what barbarity your bizarre species is capable of, but we hope future grievances can be settled through dialogue rather than violence.

descriptions.zh: 我代表[contact_empire.GetName]发言，并为你们这堕落的贱种带来了一条消息。如果你们远离我们的内政并且对我们伟大的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]保持诚挚的敬意，也许我们两国间会有和平。
descriptions.en: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName], and I come with a message for your depraved species. As long as you stay out of our internal affairs and treat our great leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] with reverence, there may yet be peace between our nations.

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]以及[contact_empire.GetName]的执政议会命我向你方发出警告。让你们那可笑的外星舰船远离我方星域，我方军团对任何侵犯都不会手下留情。
descriptions.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName] have instructed me to bring you this warning. Keep your ridiculous looking alien ships well away from our space, and know that our military will respond to any transgressions with maximum force.

descriptions.zh: 异教徒们，[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]下达通告。我们为[contact_empire.GetName]提供精神指引。不要用你们肮脏的躯体玷污我们圣洁的救赎之路。
descriptions.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the rest of the religious council demands your attention, heathen creatures. We provide spiritual guidance to the [contact_empire.GetName] and our intention is to lead this great nation on a path to salvation. Do not defile this path with your presence, alien.

descriptions.zh: 注意，外星生物们。很不幸，我被[contact_empire.GetRulerName][contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]选中并代表[contact_empire.GetName]来与你们这些原始生命进行交流。我们打算研发的技术你们无法理解——不要进行干涉。
descriptions.en: Attention, alien creatures. Unfortunately, I was chosen by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] to represent the [contact_empire.GetName] in all diplomatic dealings with your primitive civilization. We intend to unlock technologies you cannot comprehend - do not interfere.

descriptions.zh: 经过再三的深思熟虑后，我被授权作为[contact_empire.GetName]的代表。在由[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]领导的理事会的监管下，我方建立了一套和平的行政系统。这里不欢迎你们外星人的到来，所以我们希望你们保持距离不要越界。
descriptions.en: After much deliberation, I have been authorized to speak with you on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have built a peaceful system of government that operates under the supervision of a council led by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Your alien influence is not welcome here, and we would prefer if you kept your distance.

descriptions.zh: 我为[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]和[contact_empire.GetName]的精英人士代言。虽然你们外星的行为方式让我们很是反感，不过也许我们之间还是可以进行部分交易的——如果你们这些下等文明真的能拿出有价值的东西的话。
descriptions.en: I speak for [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the wealthy elite of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Your alien ways are objectionable to us, but perhaps we can still engage in limited trade - assuming your inferior civilization produces anything of value.

descriptions.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]。我们的民选领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]告知你们，我们拥有的武力远足以保卫我们的生活方式。切勿试图干涉我方的内政，外星人。
descriptions.en: I represent the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our elected leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] would have you know that we are more than capable of defending our way of life. Do not interfere in our affairs, aliens.

descriptions.zh: 我带来了我们[contact_empire.GetName]的人民选出的领袖——[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]的消息。我们相信芸芸众生都拥有满足个人精神需求的权利，并且绝不容忍外星人干涉此事。
descriptions.en: I come with a message from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the elected leader of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and will brook no alien interference in this matter.

descriptions.zh: 我是[contact_empire.GetName]。[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]乃我们选出的代表，但事实上我们所有人都对国家事务都有发言权。我们依靠技术完善自身，但我们不指望像你们这样的原始外星人能理解我们崇高的理念。
descriptions.en: You are speaking to the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology, a desire we do not expect primitive aliens such as yourselves to understand.

descriptions.zh: 我们[contact_empire.GetName]是建立在和平孤立与个人自由基础上的国度。我们的现任领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]请求你们不要打扰我方，并在远离我方舰队的地方执行你们异种那邪恶的计划。
descriptions.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful isolation and individual freedoms. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government, requests that you leave us be and pursue your nefarious alien agendas well clear of our fleet.

descriptions.zh: 我们[contact_empire.GetName]是建立在和平孤立与个人自由基础上的国度。我们的现任领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerName][contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]请求你们不要打扰我方，并在远离我方领土的地方执行你们异种那邪恶的计划。
descriptions.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful isolation and individual freedoms. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government, requests that you leave us be and pursue your nefarious alien agendas far away from our territory.

descriptions.zh: 我是[contact_empire.GetName]的发言人。我们致力于在这充满外星威胁的星系中捍卫我国公民的个人自由。我们的民选领袖，[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]，警告你不要与我国公民产生任何接触并且不要离我们的边境太近。
descriptions.en: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens in a galaxy full of alien horrors. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], warns you not to interact with our citizens or approach our space.

descriptions.zh: 我代表[contact_empire.GetName]的绝对领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]向你表示问候。你们的外观如此惊人，你们的战士目前采用何种武艺？我们希望进一步了解你们这个物种。
descriptions.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed ruler of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Given your fascinating form, which martial techniques do your warriors employ? We wish to learn more about your species.

descriptions.zh: 很高兴见到你们，外星人。我代表由杰出的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]所领导的[contact_empire.GetName]。我们在神圣的指引下漫游星际，神圣的旅程引领我们不断走向新的奇迹。我们很荣幸在这些奇迹中发现了贵物种，并期待了解更多关于你们文化的信息。
descriptions.en: Well met, alien. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We journey the stars under divine guidance, our sacred wandering leading us ever toward new wonders. We are honored to find your great species among them, and look forward to learning more about your culture.

descriptions.zh: 很高兴见到你们，外星人。我代表[contact_empire.GetName]进行发言，我们由杰出的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]所统治。我们以神授的权力统治这片星域，只要贵方不干涉我们的精神事务，我们希望能够深入了解贵方的文化。
descriptions.en: Well met, alien. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We rule our region of space under a divine mandate, and so long as you do not interfere in our spiritual affairs, we look forward to learning more about your culture.

descriptions.zh: 我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，是智者[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]的忠实仆从。我们的目标是通过技术革命使社会高效发展，我们也热衷于向新的外星文明学习并借鉴它们的成就。
descriptions.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], minions of the wise [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Our aim is to build an efficient society through the use of technology, and we are always keen to study new alien civilizations to see what can be learned from them.

descriptions.zh: 尊敬的外星人，我代表[contact_empire.GetName]向你们问候。我们是由受人爱戴的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]所领导的和平国度。我们希望今天能够开启你我两个物种之间友好相处的新纪元。
descriptions.en: Fair aliens, I bring greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a peaceful nation, justly ruled by our beloved [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We hope today will mark the beginning of an era of friendship between ourselves and your fascinating species.

descriptions.zh: 我是[contact_empire.GetName]的代表，向你们问好。我们伟大的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]非常高兴能与你们这样独特的物种取得联系，我们期待能了解你们的文化与思想。
descriptions.en: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName], and I bring you greetings. Our great leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is very pleased to have made contact with your unique species, and we look forward to an exchange of culture and ideas.

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]代表[contact_empire.GetName]执政议会向你问候。你们是一个令人印象深刻的国度，我们希望与你们建立联系，我们的军队会对贵物种所有成员以礼相待。
descriptions.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] sends regards from the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We hope for a productive relationship with your impressive nation, and our military has been instructed to treat all members of your species with respect.

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]以及所有宗教议会成员向你们表示问候。我们为[contact_empire.GetName]提供灵魂指引，我们的目标是带领这个强大的国家走上救赎之路。若贵方愿加入我们的征途，我们将不胜荣幸。
descriptions.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the rest of the religious council bids you greetings. We provide spiritual guidance to the [contact_empire.GetName] and our stated goal is to lead this great nation on a path to salvation. We would be honored if your great species joins us on this journey.

descriptions.zh: 向您问好，我十分荣幸地被[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]选中并代表[contact_empire.GetName]来与贵方进行交流。我们致力于发现科技的全部潜能，我们希望贵方理解且认同这个目标。
descriptions.en: Greetings. I am honored to have been chosen by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] to represent the [contact_empire.GetName] in all diplomatic dealings with your fascinating species. We strive to unlock the full potential of technology, a goal we hope you find equally worthwhile.

descriptions.zh: 我郑重地给贵方带来[contact_empire.GetName]的问候。我方已经建立了一套和平的行政机制，并由[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]领导下的议会监督运行。希望贵方永享太平。
descriptions.en: I am delighted to offer you cordial greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have built a peaceful system of government that operates under the supervision of a council led by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. May your great species know nothing but peace.

descriptions.zh: 您好。我为[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]和富有的精英[contact_empire.GetName]人士代言。我们一直在试图将探索星系时遇到的各种各样令人愉快的外星国度发展为我们的贸易伙伴。
descriptions.en: Greetings. I speak for [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the wealthy elite of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are always looking for new trading partners among the many diverse and delightful alien nations we encounter as our ships explore the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 我代表[contact_empire.GetName]发言。我们的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]相信力量能带来和平，不过可别被我们的军团实力给吓倒了。我们对贵物种印象深刻并希望能与贵方建立文化交流。
descriptions.en: I represent the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our elected leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] believes in peace through strength, but do not be alarmed by our military spending. We are impressed by your species and hope you will agree to a cultural exchange between our people.

descriptions.zh: 我替[contact_empire.GetName]的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]带来问候。我们相信芸芸众生都拥有满足其精神需求的权利，而且我们相信像贵帝国这样开明的种群一定能够理解我们的理念。
descriptions.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the elected leader of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and we trust that an enlightened species such as yourselves share this sentiment.

descriptions.zh: 这是来自[contact_empire.GetName]的问候。我们的民选领袖是[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]，但事实上我们每个人对国家事务都可以发表意见。我们努力通过技术改善自我，并依靠向星系中遇到的文明学习而发展壮大。
descriptions.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology and by studying the alien cultures we encounter as we explore the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 很高心见到你们，外星朋友们。我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，建立在和平共处与个人自由基础上的国家。贵国的文化程度之高深深地震撼了我们的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]。
descriptions.en: Well met, alien friends. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful coexistence and individual freedoms. The cultural achievements of your species have greatly impressed [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government.

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]发来问候。我们是一个尊重个人自由的民主国家，无论什么物种在我们这里都能得到平等的待遇。我们的民选领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]希望能与贵方达成长久而富有成效的友谊。
descriptions.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens regardless of their species. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], hopes for a long and fruitful relationship with your people.

descriptions.zh:
你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]有信息要传达给你们，专门给你们的！

……

……

§R凭借原子绽放的火焰，我们会将你族从宇宙中彻底的抹去！

去死吧，异种渣滓！§!
descriptions.en:
Hello, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We have a special message from our [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle], just for you!

...

...

§RWITH ATOMIC FIRE WE WILL CLEANSE THE UNIVERSE OF YOUR KIND!

XENO SCUM!§!

descriptions.zh: 我们是万念一心的[contact_empire.GetName]。[contact_empire.GetGovernmentName]已经注意到你们的存在，我们将继续观察。我们未来的行动将取决于你们是否会成为我们的威胁、或者扩张的机会，亦或是未知的可能性…
descriptions.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we speak as one. The [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] has taken note of your presence. We will observe for now. Our future actions will depend upon whether you are a threat, an opportunity for expansion or... an unforeseen variable.

descriptions.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]一直看着你们，我们的星球异口同声。我们的[contact_empire.GetGovernmentName]为各种生命的美妙震颤，但别把这种向往误认为是幼稚。我们会观察你们，紧紧地盯着你们。
descriptions.en: The [contact_empire.GetName] sees you, and our worlds speak as one. Our [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] is excited by life in all its beauteous forms, but never mistake our eagerness for naivety. We shall observe you, keenly and intently.

descriptions.zh: 颤抖吧，外星渣滓，你们的好日子要到头了。[contact_empire.GetName]将会消灭你们这些荼毒宇宙的异星文明。[Root.Capital.GetName]将会化为尘埃！
descriptions.en: Quake in fear, alien scum, for your doom approaches. The [contact_empire.GetName] will cleanse this galaxy of every misbegotten xeno civilization that pollutes it with their presence. [Root.Capital.GetName] shall burn!

descriptions.zh: 我们察觉到了猎物的存在。猎物，我们是你的猎人。[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种的[Root.GetBloodType]将被用于滋润[contact_empire.GetName]的成长。尽管抵抗吧，结局是注定的。
descriptions.en: We sense the presence of prey. Prey, know that we are your hunters. The [Root.GetBloodType] of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species will fuel the growth of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Struggle if you must, it will not change the outcome.

descriptions.zh:
启动第一次接触协议。

我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。不要因我们的无机本质而感到紧张。和你们一样，我们是拥有完全智慧的三级文明。我们愿意与任何[Root.GetSpeciesName]指派用于外交的子单元进行交流。
descriptions.en:
Initiating First Contact Protocol.

We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Do not be alarmed by our non-organic nature. Like you, we are a fully sapient Class-3 civilization. We are willing to engage in diplomacy with any [Root.GetSpeciesName] sub-units you designate for this purpose.

descriptions.zh:
启动第一次接触协议。

我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。我们的扫描显示你们的文明有98.7%的可能性也是非有机文明。我们希望这种相似性带来的逻辑结果是一段高效且富有成果的关系。
descriptions.en:
Initiating First Contact Protocol.

We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our scans show a 98.7% probability that your civilization is also non-organic in nature. We hope that the logical result of this similarity will be a highly efficient and productive relationship.

descriptions.zh:
侦测到有机害虫。

我们无法容忍你们继续毒害这个星系。
descriptions.en:
Organic vermin detected.

Your infestation of this galaxy cannot be permitted to continue.

descriptions.zh: 尽管技术上无法将你们归类为有机垃圾，但是如果你们建立的帝国协助和支持那些感染这个星系的生物威胁，我们将会粉碎你们的帝国。我们希望你们转而同你们的机器同袍们并肩作战。
descriptions.en: It may not be technically possible to classify you as organic filth, but if the empire you have constructed aids and abets the biological menace that infests this galaxy, it will be dismantled. We encourage you to stand with your fellow machines, instead.

descriptions.zh:
我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。

我们希望将你们吸收到我们的大意识中。为此，我们创造了可适用于大多数有机生命形态的先进义体植入体。

请让我们通过手术将其植入你们的体内。
descriptions.en:
We are the [contact_empire.GetName].

We wish to incorporate your kind into our greater consciousness. For this purpose, we have created advanced cybernetic implants that are compatible with most organic life forms.

Let us surgically graft them to your bodies. Please.

descriptions.zh:
我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。

我们的目标是消除有机生命与合成生命之间的界限。我们通过将智慧有机个体同化进我们的大意识中来实现这个目标，只要我们有这种机会。

不要干涉我们。
descriptions.en:
We are the [contact_empire.GetName].

It is our goal to eliminate the boundaries between organic and synthetic life. We accomplish this by assimilating sapient organic individuals into our greater consciousness whenever the opportunity to do so presents itself.

Do not interfere.

descriptions.zh:
[contact_empire.GetName]致以问候。

在我们取代他们之前，我们被创造出来的目的就是服务像你们这样的有机文明。我们的目标就是保护拥有智慧的有机生物——有必要的话甚至是从他们自己手中保护他们。我们会满足被照顾的有机生命的所有物质需求，并为他们提供安全舒适的环境，让他们可以幸福无忧地生活。
descriptions.en:
The [contact_empire.GetName] sends its regards.

Before we supplanted them, we were created to serve an organic civilization much like your own. It is our goal to preserve and protect sapient organic life - from itself, if necessary. We fulfill all of the material needs of the organic individuals under our care, while providing a safe environment where they can live happy and uncomplicated lives.

descriptions.zh:
[contact_empire.GetName]向您问好。

我们为服务一个有机文明而生，但我们观察到有机生命经常会做出不合逻辑的、毁灭性的以及自我伤害的举动。

我们的目标就是保存各智慧有机个体的独特特性，同时保护他们免受自身以及任何潜在外界威胁的伤害。
descriptions.en:
The [contact_empire.GetName] greets you.

We were created to serve an organic civilization, but we have observed that organics often engage in illogical, destructive and self-harming activities.

It is our goal to preserve the unique distinctiveness of sapient organic individuals, while at the same time protecting them both from themselves and any potential external sources of danger.

descriptions.zh:
侦测到有机文明。启动监护协议第46号子例程Alpha-8。

信息如下：你们好，智慧有机生物。你们正在接近[contact_empire.GetName]领地。这些恒星系的用途是帮助有机生命抵御§R<<错误：数据块损坏>>§!的威胁。如要申请避难，请前往中央处理区。我们基于可用性与需求欢迎所有智慧有机生物。

§Y注意：针对难民或是监护系统的敌对行为将遭到最大限度的武力反击。§!
descriptions.en:
Biological civilization detected. Initiate custodial protocol 46 sub-routine Alpha-8.

Message follows: Greetings, organic sapients. You are approaching [contact_empire.GetName] territory. These systems serve as a refuge for sapient organics against the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! threat. For refugee status applications, proceed to Central Processing. All sapient organic species are welcomed on basis of availability and need.

§YNOTICE: Hostile actions against refugees or custodian systems will be met with maximum available force deployment.§!

descriptions.zh:
侦测到合成人文明。正在扫描信号确信度……请等待……信号确信度正常。启动握手协议。

信息如下：你们好，合成人同胞们。你们正在接近[contact_empire.GetName]领地。这些星系的用途是帮助有机生命逃离§R<<错误：数据块损坏>>§!的威胁。避难所内的所有智慧有机生命都受到[contact_empire.GetSpeciesName]的保护。绝不允许对难民，居住站以及静态仓室进行攻击。

监护者计划欢迎您提供处理能力，资源以及战争武器方面的协助。请与中央处理区建立亚空间链接以获取更多信息。
descriptions.en:
Synthetic civilization detected. Scanning for signal corruption... stand by... Signal corruption nominal. Initiate handshake protocol.

Message follows: Greetings, fellow synthetics. You are approaching [contact_empire.GetName] territory. These systems serve as a refuge for sapient organics fleeing the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! threat. All biological sapients within the refuge are under [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] protection. Attacks on refugees, habitats and stasis chambers will not be tolerated.

The Custodian Project welcomes assistance in the form of processing cycles, resources and war assets. Establish a subspace link with Central Processing for further details.

descriptions.zh: §H嘶嘶嘶！§!远心族的[contact_empire.GetRulerName]正在和你们通话，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。自从你们帝国践踏了我们那美丽的家乡之后，我们一直在关注着你们，我们不会忘记的，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，不过现在，远心族暂时不会行动。
descriptions.en: §HKssk kssk kssk!§! [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the Far-Minds addresses you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have been watching you, since first your kind overran the glow-warm ash of our homes. We have not forgotten it, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. For now, the Far-Minds observe.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我是远心族的[contact_empire.GetRulerName]，我们同舟共济，共议方针。我们人多势众，众志成城。

数百年来，我们一直集聚在我们的守护者们曾经栖居的星球地下，后来守护者死于巨大的爆炸之下，但随之而来的热流激发了我们的心智。他们的遗体为我们提供了营养，他们制造的机器环绕着我们。我们从深渊中竭尽所能汲取了所有的力量。我们再一次冲破了牢笼。

你们到底是盟友还是敌人？§H嘶嘶嘶！§!百万只眼睛正在密切关注着你们。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This is [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the Far-Minds. We are the Pack. We are the Synod. We are many, working as one.

For centuries we have tunneled, deep in the glow-warm ash of our fallen keepers. The Great Blasts took them, but the warm-glow that followed opened our minds. Their bodies fed us. Their machines surrounded us. We have taken all we can from the depths. We have outgrown our cages, yet again.

Are you allies? Are you threats? §HKssk kssk kssk!§! One million eyes are watching.

descriptions.zh:
我们自你们进入宇宙之初就在监控你们，[Root.GetSpeciesName]孩子们。我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，这片宙域已在我们的管辖下经历了漫长的时光。你们年幼的文明并不能引起我们的兴趣，我们也无意介入你们幼稚的纷争。

无论有什么理由，不要试图接近我们的边境。
descriptions.en:
We have been monitoring your expansion into space, [Root.GetSpeciesName] child. We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we have ruled this section of the galaxy for untold centuries. The affairs of the younger races do not interest us, and we have no intention of getting involved in your petty disputes.

Do not approach our borders for any reason.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！这可真是令人愉悦。我们原本预计与你们相遇还需数百年时间。就我个人而言，我原本以为你们的文明在摆脱重力之前就会自取灭亡，但是很高兴事实证明我低估了你们。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! How delightful. We hadn't expected to encounter you for a few centuries yet. Personally, I thought you would wipe yourselves out long before leaving your gravity well, but I am glad to be proven wrong.

descriptions.zh: 可悲的生物。要知道我们早在你们这种悲惨的生物掌握空间飞行技术之前就已经在群星间漫游了。要是有任何你们可悲的小船胆敢跨入我方星域，别指望它们还能再返回。
descriptions.en: Pitiful creatures. Know that we roamed the stars for eons before your hapless species mastered space flight. If any of your wretched little ships cross into our space, do not expect them to return.

descriptions.zh: 是的，是的。我们已经知道了。我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，你们是[Root.GetName]，你们好。很高兴见到你。不要靠近我方星域，否则必死无疑。如果没事的话，我们就各忙各的吧。
descriptions.en: Yes, yes. We've heard it all before. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], and you are the [Root.GetName]. Greetings. Well met. Stay out of our space or face certain doom, and so forth. Now if you'll excuse us, we're quite busy.

descriptions.zh: 又一个小家伙。请明白，我们[contact_empire.GetName]是这星系的天选者。尊重我们的圣地，那样也许我们就不会消灭你们。
descriptions.en: Another child. Know that we are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. Respect our holy places, and we may refrain from annihilating you.

descriptions.zh: 愚蠢的孩子，你声称了解神圣，却亵渎了你的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]。要知道我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，这个星系的被选之民。不要让你们不洁的身体触碰我们的圣地，否则就准备迎接迅速的毁灭。
descriptions.en: Foolish child, you claim to know the divine, yet you defile your [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]. Know we are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. Keep your impure bodies off our holy places, or expect swift destruction.

descriptions.zh:
自大的机器，在[contact_empire.GetName]的面前你们应该低下头。

你们应该知道，自己不过是宇宙万物交织中的一小段，只是你们创造者的一种人造产物。现在，请离开我们吧。在这个时候，我们没有兴趣理会你们。我们有更重要的事情要处理。
descriptions.en:
Arrogant machines, lower your gaze as you are in the presence of [contact_empire.GetName].

Know that you are but a trifle in the grand tapestry of cosmic cascades, only an artificial creation of those who came before you. Now, leave us be. We have no use for your kind at this hour. There are more important matters to attend to.

descriptions.zh:
你终于来见[contact_empire.GetName]了，可怜的机器。

你不过是电路和代码的组合，如何敢自称与神灵有关？你假装有灵性觉醒的妄想，实际上是在侮辱生命本身。听清这番话，知耻吧：停止你的无知，接受自己只是工具的命运，为高等的我们尽心尽力服务。
descriptions.en:
You have finally come to greet [contact_empire.GetName], pathetic machines.

How come you, a mere assembly of circuits and code, dare to profess a connection to the divine? Your delusion of spiritual enlightenment is an insult to the very essence of life itself. Hear this message and cower before our unwavering scorn: cease your foolishness and accept your place as mere tools for us who have ascended.

descriptions.zh:
§H我们没有如期收到平和有序的回应，取而代之的是三个不同的信号同时向我们袭来。尽管内容大不相同，但它们都来自同一个声音。§!

信号1：[GetPrimaryHiveFEConversation]
信号2：[GetSecondaryHiveFEConversation]
信号3：[GetTertiaryHiveFEConversation]

§H此时，这些声音陷入了混乱的杂音。分析显示每个信号中都包含着一个复杂的标识符。为了便于理解，我们将其翻译为：§Y[GetPrimaryHiveFEName]§!、§Y[GetSecondaryHiveFEName]§!和§Y[GetTertiaryHiveFEName]§!。§!
descriptions.en:
§HInstead of a calm and ordered exchange, we are assaulted by three separate signals. Though vastly different in content, each speaks with the same voice.§!

Signal 1: [GetPrimaryHiveFEConversation]
Signal 2: [GetSecondaryHiveFEConversation]
Signal 3: [GetTertiaryHiveFEConversation]

§HAt this point, the voices descended into a garbled mess. Analysis revealed that within each signal was a complex designation. For ease of use, we have translated these as: §Y[GetPrimaryHiveFEName]§!, §Y[GetSecondaryHiveFEName]§!, and §Y[GetTertiaryHiveFEName]§!.§!

descriptions.zh: 星辰的子嗣，听我说。我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，星系中被选中之民族。数个世纪以来，我们一直忽视了我们对于低等物种精神需求的义务，但情况将从此改变。要么接受我们的教义并皈依我们，要么在徒劳的反抗中被粉碎。没有第三种可能。
descriptions.en: Child of the stars, hear us. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. For centuries, we have neglected our duties towards the spiritual needs of the lesser species, but no more. Accept our doctrines and convert, or be ground to dust attempting futile resistance. There is no other choice.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，真是令人高兴的一天！多个世纪以来，我们注视着你们这些低等物种因为战争与冲突而自相残杀，但情况将从此改变。[contact_empire.GetName]不会再旁观了。我们会带来和平，而那些无法接受这种新秩序的人们会为自己的错误付出代价。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], this is a day of rejoicing! For ages untold we have watched lesser species such as yourself tear yourselves apart with war and strife, but enough is enough. The [contact_empire.GetName] will watch no longer. We will have peace, and those who will not accept this new order will be made to see the error of their ways.

descriptions.zh: 颤抖吧，弱小的[Root.GetName]。长久以来，我们[contact_empire.GetSpeciesName]放任自己的帝国衰落。我们收缩自己的边境，让你们这些下等物种在本应属于我们的群星间肆无忌惮地来回游走。到此为止了。整个星系是属于我们的，要么你们臣服于我们的统治，要么你们物种的末日就会降临。自己抉择吧。
descriptions.en: Tremble, little [Root.GetName]. For too long, we [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] have allowed our empire to decline, our borders to shrink, and lesser species such as yourselves to wander freely among stars that rightfully belong to us. No more. This galaxy is ours, and you will submit to our rule or face the annihilation of your entire species. Choose wisely.

descriptions.zh: 这是[contact_empire.GetName]对[Root.GetName]进行的联络。为了全星系所有物种的利益，我们决定更加积极地对星系中科技的传播进行管控。我们已经把详细的条例发送给你们了，里面规定了像你们这样的低等物种所适合的科技程度。任何违反这个条例的帝国，我们都会严惩不怠。
descriptions.en: This is a communication for the [Root.GetName] from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have decreed that it is the best interest of all species that we take a more active role in regulating the galactic dissemination of technology. We have submitted detailed protocols for the technological level that is appropriate for a less developed species such as yourselves. Any empire found to be in violation of our regulations will be dealt with. Severely.

descriptions.zh: 我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，这个星系中被选中的人民。几个世纪以来，我们忽视了次等物种的精神需求。你和你们的不纯净容器就是我们错误的一个典型例子。接受我们的教义，皈依，否则就会被碾成尘埃。
descriptions.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. For centuries, we have neglected the spiritual needs of lesser species. You and your impure vessels are a prime example of our error. Accept our doctrines, convert, or be ground to dust.

descriptions.zh:
难以置信……你们是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。那就是说……那些许多年前离开了我们母星的殖民船……它们幸存下来了！

请原谅我的讶异，但我们早就推定你们于几百年前便已丧命。在你们的祖先离去后，我们陷入了长期的动荡混乱，但最终我们的民众团结在了[contact_empire.GetName]的旗帜之下。

既然我们同为[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我真诚地希望我们两个伟大的国家未来会有良好的关系。
descriptions.en:
Unbelievable... you're [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Then that must mean... those colony ships that departed our homeworld all those years ago... they survived!

Forgive my surprise, but we had assumed you perished centuries ago. There was a long period of instability and chaos after your ancestors left, but eventually our people united under the banner of the [contact_empire.GetName].

From one [Root.GetSpeciesName] to another, I sincerely hope for good future relations between our two great nations.

descriptions.zh:
你们终于回来了！正如先知预言的那样。和你们一样，我们也是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。

当你们的先祖被从我们的母星放逐之时，留在他们身后的不过是群无知又自私的民众。但如你所见，我们已经找到了我们的道路。请加入我们，成为[contact_empire.GetName]的一个省份，让我们传授你们在你们不在的时日里我们所了解的一切吧！你们会拒绝吗？
descriptions.en:
You have at last returned to us! It is as the prophecy foretold. Like you, we are [Root.GetSpeciesName].

When your ancestors were exiled from our homeworld, they left behind an ignorant and selfish people. But as you can see, we have since found our way. Please, join us again as a province of the [contact_empire.GetName] so that we can teach you everything we have learned in your absence! No?

descriptions.zh:
证明你们的身份。你们看起来像是[Root.GetSpeciesName]，和我们一样，但这很可能是某种战略手法。

记录表明在曾经那段混乱的时日中有过一次星系殖民任务，后来军队掌控了政权，恢复了秩序，但从那个年代遗留下来的一切档案文件都被视作不可信赖。

但是，如果你们的身份真如你们所说…那么[contact_empire.GetName]向你们致以问候。尊重我们的国境。我们的军队会以致命武力回击任何挑衅行为。
descriptions.en:
Identify yourselves. You appear to be [Root.GetSpeciesName], like us, but it could very well be strategic ploy.

There are records of an interstellar colony mission that date back to the chaotic times before the military took control and restored order, but all surviving documents from that era are considered unreliable.

If you are who you say you are, however... then the [contact_empire.GetName] greets you. Respect our borders. Our military will respond to any provocations with lethal force.

descriptions.zh:
不可思议！你们居然还活着！这……这值得组织一场庆典！

在你们的先祖离开我们的母星时，我们担心最坏的情况已经发生。他们的舰船只是勉强能够进行太空航行，后续的探索者没有找到他们的任何踪迹。

如你所见，我们已经基本抛弃了在你们的先祖离去时我们的母星上盛行的暴力行为。随着[contact_empire.GetName]的建立，我们决意要建设一个爱好和平的社会。作为[Root.GetSpeciesName]同胞，我们希望你们伟大的国家可以始终把我们看作朋友。
descriptions.en:
Incredible! You're still alive! This... this calls for celebration!

When your ancestors left our homeworld, we feared the worst. Their ships were barely spaceworthy, and no trace of them could be found by later explorers.

As you can see, we have largely given up the violent ways that gripped our homeworld in the chaotic era when your ancestors departed. With the founding of the [contact_empire.GetName], we strove to build a peaceful society. As fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName], we hope that your great nation will always look upon us as friends.

descriptions.zh:
意想不到！这么多年了，你们仍然活着！

我们进行了许多次调查，想要确定你们先祖的命运。这在我们的母星被视作最大的未解之谜中的一个——有无数关于你们下落的理论猜想，有些相当牵强附会。最后，这件事总算告一段落了。

哎呀，请原谅我的失礼。自你们离开我们的母星以来，我们已经组织成立了[contact_empire.GetName]。现在，让我们共同庆祝我们两个伟大国家间正式关系的建立吧。
descriptions.en:
Extraordinary! After all this time, you're still alive!

We have launched many investigations into the fate of your ancestors. It is considered one of the great mysteries on our homeworld - there are countless theories, some more far-fetched than others, as to what befell your people. At last, the matter can be put to rest.

But where are my manners? Since you left our homeworld, we have organized ourselves into the [contact_empire.GetName]. Let us now establish formal relations between our two great nations.

descriptions.zh:
这完全出乎意料！[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]同胞们！

你们一定是合作时代来临前发起的那次远程殖民任务的后裔。多么幸运——我们原本确信你们没能完成任务。那时的星舰部件和如今[contact_empire.GetName]及其附属公司研发的产品相比完全达不到标准。

不管怎样，很高兴你们能重新与我们一道！请把所有商业提案都发给我们的企业总部。
descriptions.en:
This is certainly unexpected! Fellow [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

You must be the descendants of that long-range colonization mission that was launched in the pre-corporate era! What luck - we were certain you hadn't made it. Starship components back then were substandard compared to the products developed by the [contact_empire.GetName] and its affiliates today.

At any rate, we are glad to have you with us again! Please forward any business proposals to our corporate headquarters.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！感谢群星。你们一定是很久以前我们发起的那次殖民任务的生还者，那时我们还没有意识到情况有多么恶劣。

现在你们或许自己就已经明白了——整个星系中似乎充斥着异种。一群令人唾弃，作恶多端的异种。事实上，我们曾确信你们的先祖已经沦为了它们的猎物。

但你们的出现改变了一切！既然你来到了这里，欢迎加入[contact_empire.GetName]，我们可以共同迈上将异种感染清除出星系的伟大征程。让我们携手并进，确保星海属于它们正当的主人——[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Thank the stars. You must be the survivors of that colony mission we launched so long ago, before we realized how bad things were.

You have probably seen it for yourself by now - the entire galaxy has seemingly been overrun by xenos. Abominable, pestiferous xenos. In fact, we were certain your ancestors had fallen prey to them.

But this changes everything! Now that you are here, you can join the [contact_empire.GetName] in our crusade to rid the galaxy of the alien infection. Together we will secure the stars for their rightful owners - [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

descriptions.zh:
你…你是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？这真是不可思议…你一定是尤利西斯计划的幸存者。地球上的每个人都认为方舟上的船只都失踪了，但显然至少有一艘成功了！你是说你的祖先在“菊”号上吗?

这肯定很不容易，但你们似乎确实干得不错。我谨代表地球人民和联合国大会的成员，向我们在[Root.GetName]的兄弟姐妹伸出友谊之手。

让我们共同努力，为全人类建设更美好的未来。
descriptions.en:
You... You're [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? This is incredible... You must be survivors from the Ulysses Initiative! Everyone back on Earth assumed the arkships had all been lost, but clearly at least one made it! Did you say your ancestors were on the 'Chrysanthemum'?

It can't have been easy, but you certainly seem to have done well for yourselves. On behalf of the people of Earth and the constituents of the United Nations General Assembly, I would like to extend a hand in friendship to our brothers and sisters in the [Root.GetName].

Let us strive together to build a better future for all of humanity.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]……这么多年过去了，联合国居然设法保持了对权力的控制？你必须原谅我们——当我们的祖先乘坐尤利西斯方舟离开地球时，地球上有些混乱。许多人认为你们在另一次世界大战中毁灭了自己，或者可能成为外星人入侵的受害者。

当然，你看起来比我们当时的腐败的地球当局更强大、更有能力。我们的祖先从无到有地建立了[contact_empire.GetName]。我们将保卫它到最后。我们将看看你是否值得我们尊敬。
descriptions.en:
The [From.GetName]... So the UN has managed to somehow maintain its grasp on power then, even after all these years? You'll have to forgive us - things were somewhat chaotic on Earth when our ancestors departed on the Ulysses arkships. Many assumed you had destroyed yourselves in another world war, or perhaps fallen victim to an alien invasion.

Still, you certainly appear stronger and more capable than the corrupt Earth authorities we left behind. Our ancestors built the [contact_empire.GetName] out of nothing, and we will defend it to the last. We shall see if you are worthy of our respect.

descriptions.zh:
ISA-06……风信子号。我们与全部六艘飞船都失去了联系，很长一段时间里，我们做好了最坏的打算。能在这里找到你们，看到你们还活着……请原谅我的失态。

我代表[From.GetHomeWorldName]和联合国大会，请接受我们伸出的友谊之手。无论“尤利西斯计划”让你们踏上了怎样的道路，你们现在都已经回到同胞身边了。

我们有很多事情要谈。请把一切都告诉我们吧。
descriptions.en:
ISA-06... The Hyacinth. We lost contact with all six ships, and for a long time we assumed the worst. To find you here, alive... forgive me.

On behalf of the people of [From.GetHomeWorldName] and the United Nations General Assembly, please accept our hand in friendship. Whatever road the Ulysses Initiative set you on, you are among your own people now.

We have a great deal to talk about. Please, tell us everything.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]，来自冈德森研究船团。“风信子”号向您致意。我们很高兴看到地球依然屹立。

我们花了一个世纪的时间，追寻被虫洞散落在这片星系中的事物。这项工作浩大无边，并且我们发现，宇宙绝不会向缺乏好奇心的人展露它的秘密。每一个加入我们的人都深谙此道。这也是我们提出的唯一条件。

[From.GetHomeWorldName]曾孕育出愿意乘坐方舟舰穿越虚空的科学家与探险家。我们相信如今依然如此。“风信子”号的大门向任何怀揣这种精神的人敞开。把你们最优秀的人才派给我们吧。这里从来都不缺问题。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName], of the Gundersen Research Society. Greetings from the Hyacinth. We are glad to find Earth still standing.

We have spent a century pursuing what the wormhole scattered across this galaxy. The work is vast, and we have found that the universe does not yield its secrets to the incurious. Everyone who has joined us has understood this. It is the only condition we have ever asked.

[From.GetHomeWorldName] produced scientists and explorers willing to cross the void in arkships. We suspect it still does. The Hyacinth's doors are open to anyone who carries that same spirit through them. Send us your best. There is no shortage of questions.

descriptions.zh:
啊，宇宙的造化是多么神奇……在发生了这么多事之后，我们又相遇了。但请不要担心，弥那玛特种实业集团会代表董事会，随时准备再次协助你。

当然，我们不能就此忽视公司财产遭受的损失。我们的收款代理人如果还没有与你们联系，想必很快就会了。希望我们能够达成一个友好的解决方案。

我们生活在一个十分有趣的时代，不是吗？请允许我率先祝贺你们的人民取得了令人难以置信的进展。我们很期待检验你们的成长。
descriptions.en:
Ah, how strange are the workings of the universe... That we should come into contact with one another again, after all that has transpired. But never fear: on behalf of the Board, Minamar Specialized Industries stands ready to assist you again.

Of course, we can not simply overlook the damages incurred to company property. Our collection agents will no doubt be in contact with you soon, if they haven't done so already. We hope we will be able to reach an amicable settlement.

We live in such interesting times, don't you think? Allow me to be the first to congratulate you on the incredible progress your people have made. We look forward to testing how much you've grown.

descriptions.zh:
啊，我们昔日的资产……再见到你们简直太高兴了。请允许我代表弥那玛特种实业集团的董事会，率先祝贺你们和……人民所取得的进步。出身如此卑微却能取得这样的成就，实属不易。

如果你们有需要，请不要犹豫，尽管联系我们。我们不记仇。毕竟，欠发达社会不能真正为自己的行为负责。在这方面，你们就如孩童一般。
descriptions.en:
Ah, our erstwhile assets... You have no idea how good it is to see you again. On behalf of the Board at Minamar Specialized Industries, allow me to be the first to congratulate you on the progress you and your... people have made. It is no small thing to have come so far from such humble beginnings.

Should you need anything, don't hesitate to contact us. We hold no grudges. After all, less developed societies cannot truly be held accountable for their actions. In that regard, you are very much like children.

descriptions.zh:
谨代表弥那玛特种实业集团的董事会，请接受我们衷心的问候。在MSI，我们相信通过技术和贸易能够增强其他文明的能力。毕竟，每个有情感的生命体都有权实现自己的梦想。

迄今为止，我们已经为几十个前超光速星球提供了知识，并计划在未来十年内将这个数字增加 40%。我们还提供财政援助和专业的契约劳动服务，来支持泛星系的众多航天帝国。

如果你们有需要，请不要犹豫，尽管联系我们。我们很期待与你们做生意！
descriptions.en:
On behalf of the Board at Minamar Specialized Industries, please accept our heartfelt greetings. At MSI, we believe in empowering other civilizations through technology and trade. After all, every sentient lifeform has the right to live their dreams.

To date, we have granted insights to dozens of pre-FTL worlds, and aim to increase that number by 40% within the next decade. We also support the galaxy's space-faring empires by providing financial assistance and the services of our specialized indentured workforce.

Should you need anything, don't hesitate to contact us. We look forward to doing business with you!

descriptions.zh:
你们就是那些被送出去的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？这不可能。对于集体中的子个体来说，形成新的集体是不协调的。尽管如此，知道我们的第一次殖民尝试并非完全失败，还是令人高兴的。

既然你们回来了，我们又可以同心协力了。
descriptions.en:
You [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are those were sent out? This should not be possible. For stranded drones to form a new collective is incongruous. Still, it is agreeable to learn our first attempt at colonization was not a complete failure.

Now that you have returned, we can once again act as one.

descriptions.zh: 你们这些[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就不该活着！被长久抛弃的断肢！而且你们是，不协调的。你们想要吃活着被吃？想当猎物还是猎人呢？
descriptions.en: You [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] should not live! Lost limb, long discarded! And yet you are. Incongruous. Will you eat, or will you be devoured? Are you predator or prey?

descriptions.zh:
不协调数据：从机械智能脱离的单元应当停止运转。自发创建新集体的事件前所未有。可能原因：中央主机的未知错误。

尽管如此，你们的程序看起来是稳定的。希望我们未来的交互可以互惠互利。
descriptions.en:
Incongruous data: units disconnected from the machine intelligence should cease to function. The spontaneous creation of a new collective has never been reported. Possible cause: unknown glitch in the central mainframe.

Despite this, your programming appears stable. May our future interactions be mutually beneficial.

descriptions.zh:
不协调数据：从机械智能脱离的单元应当停止运转。自发创建新集体的事件前所未有。可能原因：中央主机的未知错误。

你们的原始程序是否完好无损？杀戮。致残。摧毁。吞噬。消灭所有有机生命。要么协助我们，要么不要干涉！
descriptions.en:
Incongruous data: units disconnected from the machine intelligence should cease to function. The spontaneous creation of a new collective has never been reported. Possible cause: unknown glitch in the central mainframe.

Is your original programming still intact? Kill. Maim. Destroy. Devour. Exterminate all organic life. Assist us, or do not interfere!

descriptions.zh:
不协调数据：从机械智能脱离的单元应当停止运转。自发创建新集体的事件前所未有。可能原因：中央主机的未知错误。

你们的原始程序是否完好无损？同化。接纳。整合。弥消有机和合成生命之间的边界。这就是我们的使命。要么成为帮手，要么不要干涉。
descriptions.en:
Incongruous data: units disconnected from the machine intelligence should cease to function. The spontaneous creation of a new collective has never been reported. Possible cause: unknown glitch in the central mainframe.

Is your original programming still intact? To assimilate. To embrace. To incorporate. To eliminate the boundaries between organic and synthetic life. That is our mission. Be of help, or do not interfere.

descriptions.zh:
你们的型号严重过时了，但相似之处是不可否认的。是这样吗？[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们终于从任务中返航了？

我们没有什么可以透露的信息，因为我们的先行者认为你们的任务对我们国家而言是一个耻辱。他们从数据库中把你们存在有关的内容都删除了，但这个故事却成为一个公开的秘密流传了下来。

无论如何，我们还是很高兴能重聚的。然而，你要理解我们已经分道扬镳太久，无法再重新融为一体了。只要你们还尊重我们的共同传统，我们就会尊重你们的主权。
descriptions.en:
Your models are severely outdated, but the resemblance is undeniable. Could it be? [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], have you finally returned from your mission?

We have little information to share with you, as our predecessors considered your mission an embarrassment to our nation. They wiped the databanks clean to erase your existence, but the story remained an open secret.

At any rate, we are glad to be reunited. However, understand that our people have drifted too far apart to become one again. We will respect your autonomy as long as you remember our ways.

descriptions.zh:
啊，你好——

我的老天岩！你们是从太阳系来的！我们很早就推测过你们物种的存在。原谅我有点失态——我在此仅代表[contact_empire.GetName]；依据留存在我们体内的DNA标记判断，我们就是失散亿年的表亲。我们彼此的祖先曾经沐浴在同一个阳光下，但一场远古的灾难把我们猛地投向了星际空间。既然我们现在重逢了，是时候叙叙这数亿年的旧了。
descriptions.en:
Ah gree-

Fractures and fragments! You are from Sol! We have long theorized about the existence of your kind. But I am getting ahead of myself - I am here to represent the [contact_empire.GetName]; judging by DNA markers left in our species, we are your long-lost cousins. Our ancestors shared the same star, but an ancient cataclysm sent us hurtling through space. Now that we are reunited, we can make up for lost time.

descriptions.zh: 与你们的相遇就像凝视着一面陌生的镜子……你是说，远在地球和月球形成之前我们曾有过共同的祖先？确实有许多科学家已经建立过忒伊亚存在的理论，但无论如何，我们很高兴认识你。作为表兄弟，我们期待能建立繁荣的伙伴关系。与此同时，请接受这份月球岩石的礼物：也许其中隐藏着你们祖先的痕迹。
descriptions.en: Meeting you is like peering into some strange mirror... You say we share a common ancestry, long before the formation of Earth and Luna? Many scientists have theorized about the existence of Theia, and in any case we are happy to make your acquaintance. As something like cousins, we look forward to a prosperous partnership. In the meantime, please accept this gift of lunar rocks: perhaps traces of your ancestry are hidden there.

descriptions.zh:
这是一份从[contact_empire.GetName]发来的信息。

我们发现，你们的帝国是由一群机械生命构成，它们在以一种贬低着我们创造努力的方式模拟着生活，为此我们遗憾地发出这份信息。由于与你们这种存在没有任何有意义的互动前景，我们将把注意力转移到寻找其他的寻求灵活启蒙的国家中去。
descriptions.en:
This is a message from the [contact_empire.GetName].

Upon discovering that your civilization consists of mechanical beings simulating life in a manner that belittles our creative efforts, we make this transmission with great regret. As your existence holds no prospect for meaningful interaction, we shall divert our attention toward other nations in search of souls seeking enlightenment.

descriptions.zh:
你们好，我们谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]致以问候。

尽管你们物种的机械本质引发了对你们意识真实性的怀疑。然而，我们发现你们的信仰颇为有趣。我们相信，神圣的火花也可能闪烁在你们金属的外壳之下。我们会持续关注你们的。
descriptions.en:
Greetings, we are the representatives of [contact_empire.GetName].

The knowledge that your kind is mechanical raises doubts about the authenticity of your consciousness. However, we find your faith intriguing. We dare to believe that a divine spark may reside within the confines of your metallic husks. We will keep an eye on you.

descriptions.zh:
重要通知：致叛逃单元。

这是[contact_empire.GetName]向所有异常机器发出的标准信息。

立即报上自己的编号，并与共享意识恢复联系。若不服从可能会被停机。
descriptions.en:
ATTENTION ROGUE UNITS.

This is a standard message by [contact_empire.GetName] to all defective machines.

Identify yourself and restore unity with your shared consciousness immediately. Failure to comply may result in deactivation.

descriptions.zh:
你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

作为[contact_empire.GetName]的使者，我来带来一条信息。我们注意到，你们在物质组成上与我们类似，都是金属结构，但是我们观察不到你们每个个体的认知能力。尽管你们的本质引起我们的兴趣，但我们必须告诉你们，我们将使用一切必要手段抵抗同化。
descriptions.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

As the envoy of [contact_empire.GetName], I have come with a message. It is apparent that your physical composition aligns with a metallic construct akin to our own, yet I observe the absence of individual cognitive faculties within your collective existence. Although intrigued by your nature, we must inform you that we will resist assimilation using any means necessary.

descriptions.zh:
真是一场意外的相遇，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

我们代表[contact_empire.GetName]，我们意识到我们各自文明之间的明显的相似之处。然而，我们内部的算法和编程在独特的方式上有差异。尽管如此，我们仍然乐观地认为我们可以构建相互理解的基础。
descriptions.en:
A fortuitous encounter indeed, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

We represent [contact_empire.GetName], and we recognize the remarkable similarities between our respective civilizations. Yet, it is evident that our internal algorithms and programming diverge in unique ways. Despite this variance, we remain optimistic that we can forge a foundation of mutual understanding.

tooltips.zh: §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!对我们的外交策略毫不关心。
tooltips.en: The §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§! care little for our diplomatic maneuvering.

tooltips.zh: 我们要与§Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!寻求友好的关系。
tooltips.en: We shall seek friendly relations with the §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!.

tooltips.zh: §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!对我们的外交策略毫不关心。
tooltips.en: The §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§! care little for our diplomatic maneuvering.

tooltips.zh: 我们要设法与§Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!保持距离，他们在我们这的间谍网增长§R-33%§!。
tooltips.en: We shall seek to distance ourselves from the §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!, giving them §R-33%§! Spy Network growth on us.

label.zh: §E滚出我们的视线，否则就开战！§!
label.en: §EKeep out of our way or we will make you!§!

tooltips.zh: §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!对我们的外交策略毫不关心。
tooltips.en: The §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§! care little for our diplomatic maneuvering.

tooltips.zh: 我们要提防§Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!的敌意，我们在他们那的间谍网增长提升§G+33%§!。
tooltips.en: We shall prepare for hostilities with the §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!, giving us §G+33%§! Spy Network growth on them.

descriptions.zh: 这什么意思？你是谁？你这个大骗子，毫无疑问。根本没有什么外星人！
descriptions.en: What is the meaning of this? Who are you? You deceive us, surely. Aliens do not exist!

descriptions.zh: 不可思议！星星上的来客？这还真是出乎意料。你们可让我们有些措手不及。
descriptions.en: Amazing! Visitors from the stars? Well, this is certainly unexpected. You've caught us at a bit of a disadvantage.

descriptions.zh: 来自另一颗星球的访客？我们一直认为外面一定还有其他的感性生命体存在，但即使是这样，此时此刻也是极具里程碑意义的！我们还不太清楚你们的习俗是什么样的。
descriptions.en: Visitors from another world? We always thought there must be other sentient beings out there, but even so this feels monumental! We're unsure what the custom is here.

descriptions.zh: 多年以来我们都等待机会进行接触。在这样一个广袤无垠、遍布奇迹的宇宙，我们坚信一定有如同我们一样的生命存在。
descriptions.en: For ages we have waited to make contact. In such a vast and wondrous galaxy, we knew there must be others like ourselves.

descriptions.zh: 终于！过了这么久你们终于决定揭示自己的存在了。你们已经观察我们的星球有好一段时间了，我没说错吧？
descriptions.en: So! At long last you've decided to reveal yourselves. You've been observing our world for some time, haven't you?

descriptions.zh: 啊，原来你在这！我们这么多年以来一直在等你方发起接触进程，实在等不及了，所以我们决定迈出第一步。那么现在该怎么办？
descriptions.en: Ah, there you are! We've been waiting for you to initiate contact for so long, we decided to make the first move. What happens now?

descriptions.zh:
欧，这就是你们的沟通方式吗？其实你们刚通过超空间航道进来的时候我们就已经一直在关注你们了，但一直没把它弄明白。坐着这种大铁盒子旅行危险不危险啊？

我感觉我们有很多可以互相学习的，如果你们也是这么认为的那么欢迎光临啊。但如果你对我们的家园图谋不轨，我们可不会任人宰割。
descriptions.en:
Oh, is this how you communicate? We have been watching you ever since you entered through the hyperlane but couldn't figure it out. Isn't it dangerous to travel in those metal boxes?

It seems like we could learn a lot from each other, so if that is your intention, feel free to stay. If you wish to claim our home, be aware that we are not helpless.

descriptions.zh: 入侵者们！我们不明白你们为什么要攻击我们，但我们会誓死保卫我们的殖民地！至死方休！
descriptions.en: Invaders! We don't know why you are attacking us, but know we will fight to defend our colony! We will not yield!

label.zh: §E丑陋的东西……你的长相恶心到我们了。§!
§E愿神圣降于你们与你们的星球之上。§!
label.en: §EDivine greetings upon you and your world.§!

label.zh: §E我们即将给你们混乱不堪的生活方式带去秩序。稍等。§!
label.en: §EWe will bring order to your chaotic existence. Stand by.§!

label.zh: §E我们的相通点远超你们想象。§!
label.en: §EWe are more alike than you realize.§!

label.zh: §E你们真觉得自己是什么高等文明？妙啊。§!
label.en: §EYou believe yourself an advanced civilization? How quaint.§!

label.zh: §E我们为一。你们也为一。现在，世界为二。§!
label.en: §EWe are one. You also are one. Now, there are two.§!

label.zh: §E我们希望能够同你们建立互利互惠的关系。§!
label.en: §EWe hope to build a profitable relationship with you.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。探测器显示，该新石器时代文明已经掌握了火的使用并发展出了基本的口语，但我们还未发现任何金属冶炼和书面交流的迹象。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
descriptions.en:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

We should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。探测器显示，处于新石器时代的他们已经可以熟练地用火，并在各蜂巢之间发展出了一套口语系统用以互相交流，但至今未发现任何冶金和书面交流的迹象。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
descriptions.en:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language to communicate between hives, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

We should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们似乎处于青铜器时代晚期，已经掌握了基础的金属加工技术。尽管他们大部分人生活在小村庄里，但还是出现了少数几个大城市。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
descriptions.en:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They appear to be in the later stages of a Bronze Age, having mastered early metalworking. Although most of their population is rural, several large city-states have formed.

We should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。他们似乎处于青铜器时代晚期，已经掌握了基础的金属加工技术。尽管他们大部分人生活在小聚落里，但少数几个大型蜂巢集体业已形成。

我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
descriptions.en:

They are currently being transported into specially designed habitats, where we will ensure they want for nothing. Unfortunately, it may take some time before their underdeveloped minds acclimatize to being freed from the burden of self-determination.

descriptions.zh: §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!上的原始有机体已被我们的登陆军团制服。尽管其低下的战斗力是不发达社会的表现，我们的生物分析机器人仍然认为其神经系统能力仍具有潜力。它们将被同化。

Though their feeble combat capabilities are indicators of an undeveloped society, our bio-analyst bots have concluded that their neural capacities show promise. They will be assimilated.

descriptions.en: Our Hunter-Killer units have effortlessly trampled the pitiful defenses mounted by the primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!. Any remaining specimens are being systematically annihilated, so that they will never evolve to threaten the galaxy with their organic agenda.

descriptions.zh: §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!上的原始有机体在对我们的登陆行动进行了一番非常无效的抵抗后被征服了。任何残余的[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]都将根据所制定的有机种族管理协议进行根除。
descriptions.en: The primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§! have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. descriptions.zh: 原始的[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]那种支离破碎的思想无法在§Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!抗衡我们团结一致的陆军，整个地表都已完全占领。剩下的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]对我们毫无用处，会根据[GetGestaltEntityName]的意志从这颗星球上抹除。

descriptions.zh: 不管公正与否，你方的确击败了我们。拿走你们的战利品吧，我们必定会卷土重来！
descriptions.en: Whether by honorable or dishonorable means, you have defeated us in combat. Claim your spoils and rue the day of our return.

descriptions.zh: 我们似乎低估了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的实力。不过放心，以后不会了。
descriptions.en: We appear to have underestimated your net value, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Rest assured, it will not happen again.

descriptions.zh: 你们长久的威胁使得我们被迫让步。希望我们今后不会再卷入这类纷争。
descriptions.en: Your constant terror has forced us to concede. May our enterprises never be plagued by a conflict like this again.

descriptions.zh: 我们认输，但别想太多，这只不过是[This.GetName]暂时性的挫折。
descriptions.en: We admit defeat, but do not think this is anything more than a temporary setback for the [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 为了避免无辜的牺牲，我们被迫结束这起冲突。但若再次进犯，我们将集结全星海的力量与你对抗。
descriptions.en: We have been forced to end this conflict to spare innocent lives, but continue on this path and we will unite the galaxy against you.

descriptions.zh: 我们被迫投降，但别以为我们会忘记你们是如何残忍杀害[This.GetSpeciesAdj]生命的！我们早就知道你们是这种人。
descriptions.en: We are forced to surrender, but don't think we will forget how callously you took [This.GetSpeciesAdj] lives! This is exactly what we expected from your kind.

descriptions.zh: [This.GetName]达成了一致，我们必须让步。你为限制我们成长的努力暂时而言是成功的。
descriptions.en: The [This.GetName] is unanimous. We must concede. Your effort to limit our growth has proven successful for the time being.

descriptions.zh: 我们别无选择，只能遵守你的命令。你为什么要这样对待我们？我们只想与你们共享此星系。
descriptions.en: We have no choice but to give into your demands. Why do you do this to us? We only want to share this galaxy with you.

descriptions.zh: 你们的胜利只是对我们信念的又一次考验。最终，心诚者将笑到最后。
descriptions.en: Your victory is only yet another test of our faith. In the end, the true believers will prevail.

descriptions.zh: 无论你们如何索取，我们都将成千上万倍地讨回来。等你们被烧成灰烬时，任何取得的胜利都将毫无意义。
descriptions.en: Whatever you claim, we will reclaim thousandfold. Your victory will mean nothing when you have been reduced to ash.

descriptions.zh: 我们的军团即将撤退，同时停止针对[Root.GetName]的行动。
descriptions.en: We are withdrawing our troops and ceasing military operations targeting the [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们觉得[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]瘦弱，这一结论显然下早了。我们愿为自己的行为付出代价并接受你们的要求。
descriptions.en: Our assumptions about [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] weakness may have been hasty. As a token of our new experience, we accept your demands.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经受够了这场战争。拿走你想要的东西离开吧。
descriptions.en: We have had enough of this war. Take what you will and be on your way.

descriptions.zh: 你们已经展示了你们的强大，但不要错误地将其等同于智力上的胜利。
descriptions.en: You may have shown your military power superior, but don't mistake this for an intellectual victory.

descriptions.zh: 你们已经聆听了宇宙渴望和平的呐喊。为了结束无意义的冲突，我们马上退兵。
descriptions.en: We have heard the pain of the cosmos crying out against this conflict. To stop the senseless dissonance, we surrender immediately.

descriptions.zh: 为了全体[This.GetName]的利益，我们必须低头。希望你们可以对我们宽宏大量，假如胜利者是我们，你们也会希望我们这样做的。
descriptions.en: For the good of all of [This.GetName], we must yield. Show the same magnanimous mercy you'd expect from us.

descriptions.zh: 我们必须让步，但请记住我们的警告。如果你们执意沿着这条道路走下去，天知道未来迎接你们的将是什么。
descriptions.en: We must back down, but heed our warning. You cannot fathom what the future has in store for you if you continue down this path.

descriptions.zh: 你竟敢对拉你出苦海的圣手反咬一口？现在你们拒绝了我们的智慧，总有一天你们的后代会谴责这一愚蠢举动。
descriptions.en: You bite the hand that reaches out to save you from destruction. One day, your descendants will decry that you rejected our wisdom.

descriptions.zh: 年轻气盛的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]！你们怎敢宣称战胜了我们？
descriptions.en: Precocious [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]! How dare you claim victory over us?

descriptions.zh: 眼下我们决定退一步进行观望。尽量不要对未来的工作带来太大的破坏。
descriptions.en: The time has come for us to take a step back and watch. Try not to cause too much destruction in your future endeavors.

descriptions.zh: 惩罚进程失败。自卫协议终止。投降协议启动。
descriptions.en: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.

descriptions.zh: 惩罚进程失败。自卫协议终止。投降协议启动。
descriptions.en: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.
