descriptions.zh: 金属。
descriptions.en: Metal.

descriptions.zh: 不。这一切都不该是这样的。这种混乱。我们到底怎么了？
descriptions.en: No. No this is not how this is supposed to go. The confusion. What is wrong with us?

descriptions.zh: 啊……一个值得较量的对手……
descriptions.en: Finally. A worthy opponent...

descriptions.zh: 啊……一个值得较量的对手……
descriptions.en: Finally. A worthy opponent...

descriptions.zh: 啊……一个值得较量的对手……
descriptions.en: Finally. A worthy opponent...

descriptions.zh: 战争结束了。我们偃旗息鼓。
descriptions.en: This war is over. We admit defeat.

descriptions.zh: 是的！我们获胜了，我们是胜利者！如果你嫌自家的生命、钢铁和宝石太多的话，大可再来挑衅我们！
descriptions.en: Yes! We are victorious, we overcome! Come to us again, if your metal and gems and lives are too many!

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，目前的战势对你方有利。但只有在和平之下我们才能繁荣发展。
descriptions.en: The numbers speak in your favor, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. In peace there is prosperity.

descriptions.zh: 我们按照[This.GetSpeciesAdj]的传统光明正大地战胜了你们。制定条约是我们的特权与职责。
descriptions.en: We have defeated you in noble combat as per the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] traditions. We have the privilege and obligation to dictate the terms.

descriptions.zh: 你们讨价还价的本领很厉害，但最终还是我们技高一筹。不要低估资金雄厚的军团在市场中的价值。
descriptions.en: You drove a hard bargain, but we outbid you in the end. Don't underestimate the strength of a well-funded army in an unregulated market.

descriptions.zh: 我们终于可以将这次冲突抛到脑后了。希望这让你们明白了战争的代价。
descriptions.en: Finally, we can put this conflict behind us. We hope this has taught you the cost of war.

descriptions.zh: 最终，脆弱的[Root.GetName]被迫就范。这只是我们争夺星系主导地位的又一块垫脚石。
descriptions.en: At last the frail [Root.GetName] has been brought to heel. Just another stepping stone on our road to galactic supremacy.

descriptions.zh: 我们双方都为这场战争付出了高昂的代价，但希望你们明白不要再招惹[This.GetName]或其盟友了。
descriptions.en: We have both paid a high price for this war, but hopefully you will have learned not to threaten the [This.GetName] or its allies.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经除掉了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的威胁！我们的边境重归安宁，[This.GetSpeciesAdj]的未来又一次得以保障。
descriptions.en: We have driven out the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] menace! Our borders and the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] future are once again secure.

descriptions.zh: 从你们的角度来说，这场战争完全是徒劳的。任凭谁都无法抵御[This.GetName]的扩张。
descriptions.en: This war was always a futile effort on your behalf. None can stand against the expansion of the [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们提出的要求已经很仁慈了，你们不应该对[This.GetSpeciesAdj]怀恨在心。
descriptions.en: We have been lenient in our demands only so that you may not carry resentment against the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] people in your hearts.

descriptions.zh: 异教徒，跪下！你们发动了预言中的战争，并为你们的愚蠢付出了代价。
descriptions.en: Kneel, heathen! You have done battle with the heralds of divine providence and paid the price for your foolishness.

descriptions.zh: 不要以为这样就结束了。只要星系中还存在着[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，就不可能有真正的和平。
descriptions.en: Do not think this is the end. As long as there are [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] in the galaxy, there can be no true peace.

descriptions.zh: 为了解放[Root.GetAdj]的人民，我们采取了必要的措施。不要再妨碍我们正义的事业了。
descriptions.en: We have taken the necessary steps to bring freedom to the [Root.GetAdj] people. Don't stand in the way of our noble cause again.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，你应该清楚自己的位置。你们注定要服侍我们，而不是与我们作对。
descriptions.en: You should have known your place, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]. Your people were meant to serve us, not to fight us.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，现在你后悔妨碍[This.GetName]了吗？我们对挑战我们的统治的敌人绝不手软。
descriptions.en: Do you regret interfering with the [This.GetName] now, [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]? We are not lenient with those who upset our rule.

descriptions.zh: 今天，理智战胜了愚昧。继续在黑暗中跌跌撞撞吧，你们还将被开化的民族击败更多次。
descriptions.en: Today, reason triumphs over ignorance. Continue to stumble around in the dark, and you will suffer more defeats against enlightened people.

descriptions.zh: 通过这场胜利，我们成功了守护和平与和谐。我们不指望你能理解。
descriptions.en: Through this victory, we have sought to restore balance and harmony. We wouldn't expect you to understand.

descriptions.zh: [This.GetAdj]人民欢庆今天的胜利。我们和平的社会绝不会再次受到[Root.GetName]阴谋诡计的威胁。
descriptions.en: The [This.GetAdj] people rejoice on this day of victory. Never again shall our peaceful society be threatened by the malicious plans of the [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 今天，[Root.GetAdj]不敬者受到了正义的制裁。我们神圣的任务得以履行。
descriptions.en: Justice has been delivered upon the [Root.GetAdj] desecrators on this day. Our hallowed duties have been fulfilled.

descriptions.zh: 心存侥幸吧。败在我们手里总好过在死亡的路上一去不复返。
descriptions.en: Consider yourselves fortunate. Defeat at our hands is vastly preferable to continuing down the path to destruction.

descriptions.zh: 正如你们早就明白飞船不要离闪耀的恒星太近，现在你们明白了不要惹[This.GetName]。
descriptions.en: Just as you learned not to fly your ships too close to a brightly burning star, you have now learned not to disturb the [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 虽然挑选与消灭部分人口花费了一些精力，不过[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的人口暂时不会在对星系的生态系统产生不良影响了。
descriptions.en: It took some prudent culling, but the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population should not threaten the galactic ecosystem for a while now.

descriptions.zh: 惩罚进程完成。自卫协议终止。处罚协议启动。
descriptions.en: Punishment process complete. Self-defense protocols ended. Punitive protocols initiated.

descriptions.zh: 摧毁。
descriptions.en: Demolish.

descriptions.zh: 我们只需派出一个就足以击败你们零散的抵抗。别再试探我们了。
descriptions.en: It would only have taken one of us to defeat your splintered resistance. Do not test us again.

descriptions.zh: 够了，你们还未领悟战争的真谛。拿着这些资源，下次再好好打一场。
descriptions.en: That is enough, you have yet to learn the true meaning of War. Take these resources and put up a better fight next time.

descriptions.zh: 听好了，晚辈。我们回来可不是为了容忍这种愚蠢行为。
descriptions.en: Now listen to your elders. We did not return to suffer this foolishness.

descriptions.zh: 给工蜂更多资源。给星球更多资源。更多。更多。更多。更——
descriptions.en: More material for the drones. More material for the worlds. More. More. More. Mo-

descriptions.zh: 战争结束了。我方大获全胜！
descriptions.en: This war is over. We are victorious.

titles.zh: 与§H[From.GetName]§!通过维持现状结束战争

descriptions.zh: 好吧。没有赢家，也没有胜利者。只有失去的生命，和残骸……
descriptions.en: Very well. No winner, no victor. Only lost lives, lost scrap...

descriptions.zh: 没有明确获胜方的战争是可耻的悲剧，但有时确实无法避免。我们改日战场上再见吧。
descriptions.en: A war without a clear winner is a tragic and shameful sight, but sometimes unavoidable. Let us fight again another day.

descriptions.zh: 我们同意以当前边界为标准终止这次冲突。
descriptions.en: We will agree to end this conflict as the borders currently stand.

descriptions.zh: 帝国恢复正常，和平的历史继续进展，这对我们各自都有好处。
descriptions.en: A return to the normal state of things and resumption of peacetime activities would be best for all parties.

descriptions.zh: 鉴于目前的情况，我们应该立刻结束这次冲突。与其深陷这次冲突的泥潭不能自拔，[This.GetName]倒不如找些有意义的事来做。
descriptions.en: The circumstances dictate that we put an end to this war. The [This.GetName] has better things to do than pursue this conflict indefinitely.

descriptions.zh: 我们希望，停止敌对可以使[Root.GetName]和[This.GetName]开启全新的外交对话。
descriptions.en: We hope ceasing hostilities will open up for new diplomatic dialogue between the [Root.GetName] and the [This.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们不愿意看到你们逃脱了惩罚，但我们同样也希望你们这些卑鄙的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]至少明白不要干涉我们的事务。
descriptions.en: As much as we hate to see you escape unpunished, we hope you miserable [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] have at least learned to stay out of our business.

descriptions.zh: [This.GetName]需要时间恢复。我们同意在此结束战争。
descriptions.en: The [This.GetName] needs time to recuperate. We have agreed to end our conflict here.

descriptions.zh: 由于双方都无心进一步索取，我们希望创伤的治愈过程能够缩短。请不要因既成事实而对[This.GetSpeciesName]心存憎恨。
descriptions.en: With no further demands on either side, we hope that the healing process can be shortened. Do not resent the [This.GetSpeciesName] for what has been done.

descriptions.zh: 虽然我们没有贯彻正义，但我们只能终止战争。不过，神之惩罚终将降临到你们头上。
descriptions.en: We are forced to put an end to this without delivering proper justice, but you cannot escape the divine punishment that will befall you.

descriptions.zh: 这只是暂时的停战。我们不会放弃消灭[Root.GetSpeciesName]的使命。
descriptions.en: Consider this a ceasefire. We have not given up on our mission to eradicate the [Root.GetSpeciesName].

descriptions.zh: 停战约定应该是[Root.GetAdj]打破枷锁、争取交流对话的第一步。
descriptions.en: Negotiating a truce can be seen as the first step towards a diplomatic conversation about the liberties of the [Root.GetAdj] people.

descriptions.zh: 懒惰的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，就算拿来当苦力也没什么用。看来议和是最好的选项了。
descriptions.en: Lazy [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wouldn't be any good to us even as slaves. Peace might be the best option after all.

descriptions.zh: 乏味的战争，乏味的结局。我们还是各自去拥抱生命中更加美好的东西吧。
descriptions.en: A thoroughly dull ending to a thoroughly dull war. Let us return to the better things in life.

descriptions.zh: 考虑到目前状况，双方都不再进一步退让，就此结束冲突是最为合理的行为了。
descriptions.en: Ending the war now with no further concessions on either side is the most rational course of action, judging by its current state.

descriptions.zh: 如果双方再互相攻击，就会造成无法调节的失衡。若签订和平条约，则可保持精神上的长久均衡。
descriptions.en: If you would try to further take from us, or we from you, an imbalance would be created that cannot be corrected. A peace deal ensures continued spiritual equilibrium.

descriptions.zh: [This.GetAdj]人民同意结束这场战争，立即生效。
descriptions.en: The [This.GetAdj] people has agreed to bring an end to this war, effective immediately.

descriptions.zh: 现在，我们完全可以和平相处。但如果你们闯入了圣地，你们的未来将再无和平可言。
descriptions.en: For now, we will have peace, but there will be no peace in your future if you violate the holy sites.

descriptions.zh: 我们不会再继续向你要求什么了，但我们恳求你，请考虑一下我们的智慧，再想想如果忽略了我们的智慧会有何等的后果。
descriptions.en: We cannot demand anything further of you, but we implore you, consider our wisdom and what may happen if you ignore it.

descriptions.zh: 你们活该被碾碎，但这并不值得我们浪费宝贵的时间。看来议和是无法避免的了。
descriptions.en: You deserve to be utterly crushed, but you do not deserve our valuable time. Peace seems unavoidable after all.

descriptions.zh: 我们已深陷战争泥潭。就让我们当做什么都没发生过吧，同样也希望这样的事情以后也永远不会发生。
descriptions.en: We let ourselves get too involved in this. Let us pretend as if it never happened, and hope it does not happen again.

descriptions.zh: 现在，我们完全可以和平相处。但如果你们闯入了圣地，你们的未来将再无和平可言。

descriptions.zh: 不真实。
descriptions.en: Untrue.

descriptions.zh: 是的。我们要回归常态。变化……变化并非好事。我们可不想打破平衡
descriptions.en: Yes. We shall return to the normal. Change... Change is not good. We wouldn't want to disturb the Balance.

descriptions.zh: 令人印象深刻。若是在我们的时代，你们一定会有出色的表现。也许你们能守住沙拉什，而不像其他人那样失败。我们改日再战！
descriptions.en: Impressive. You would have done well back in our time. Perhaps you could have defended Shallash where others failed. We must do this again sometime!

descriptions.zh: 我们没有时间可以和你们过家家，星系需要我们的引导。不要再来碍我们的事了。
descriptions.en: We have no more time to waste on you, the galaxy calls for our guidance. Don't get in our way again.

descriptions.zh: 没时间再跟你们浪费了，星系需要我们的指引。别再挡我们的道。
descriptions.en: Yes, we have fed enough here. There are more well stocked larders out in the galaxy. We won't - can't starve.

descriptions.zh: 战争结束了。没有胜败。
descriptions.en: This war is over. There can be no victor this time.

label.en: We will accept this for now.

descriptions.zh: 当你把舰队派往敌方新的领土内时，§Y[From.GetName]§!战争就发生了。
descriptions.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! began while you had fleets inside your new enemies' borders.

descriptions.zh: 一支舰队在任务中失踪，他们会在友军领地内重新集合。

descriptions.zh: 大势已去。我们……我们提出无条件投降。
descriptions.en: All is lost. We... we offer our unconditional surrender.

descriptions.zh: 求你们召回舰队吧！我们已经向你们投降了！
descriptions.en: Please, call off your fleets! You have our surrender!

descriptions.zh: 我们所创的丰功伟绩……所建的一切……全都毁于一旦了。
descriptions.en: All we have accomplished... everything we have built... gone.

descriptions.zh: 愿圣灵能原谅你的罪孽……但我们决不能原谅！
descriptions.en: May the spirits forgive you for your sins... we never will.

descriptions.zh: 我们哪里做错了？我们的信仰还不够坚定吗？我们的祈祷还不够多吗？我……我不明白……
descriptions.en: Where did we fail? Was our faith lacking? Were the prayers not enough? I... I just don't understand...

descriptions.zh: 卧薪尝胆，我们将会变得比穷尽你的想象来的还要更强。
descriptions.en: By striking us down, we shall become more powerful than you could possibly imagine.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经下令让所有的剩余部队放下武器。战争结束了……一切也都结束了。
descriptions.en: We have instructed all of our remaining forces to lay down their arms. The war is over... everything is.

descriptions.zh: 我、我们向你们无条件投降。我们不干了。
descriptions.en: You... you have our unconditional surrender. We are standing down.

descriptions.zh: 告诉我们的将士们，他们无责于我们的战败。是我……是我无颜面对他们……
descriptions.en: Tell our warriors there was no shame in our defeat. I... I cannot face them...

descriptions.zh: 求你了，我们放弃一切抵抗。我们……我们就想重归和平。
descriptions.en: Please, we will offer no more resistance. We... we only want peace.

descriptions.zh: 愿整个宇宙宽恕你的罪行。
descriptions.en: May the universe forgive you for your crimes.

descriptions.zh: 我们的抵抗简直是太愚蠢了。无数的生命……无谓地牺牲了。
descriptions.en: It was foolish of us to resist. So many lives lost... all for nothing.

descriptions.zh: 在这情况下继续抵抗……就太不理智了。我们向你们全面投降。
descriptions.en: Continued resistance at this point would be... irrational. You have our total surrender.

descriptions.zh: 我们会与你们的占领部队配合，以期顺利……解散我们现在的政府。
descriptions.en: We will cooperate with your occupation forces as they see to the... dismantlement of our current government.

descriptions.zh: 我们才刚刚要解开星系奥秘的面纱。我们还有很多想知道的……
descriptions.en: We were only beginning to unlock the mysteries of the galaxy. There was so much more to learn...

descriptions.zh: 您将会在一小时之内在您的办公桌上看到董事会的集体辞呈……
descriptions.en: You will have the resignations of all Board members on your desk within the hour...

descriptions.zh: 依据我们投降书的细节，我们将会尽快开始……我们公司的破产清算。
descriptions.en: As per the details of our surrender, we shall begin the... the liquidation process of our company in a prompt manner.

descriptions.zh: 这不是我在经营蓝图上所描绘的未来……
descriptions.en: This is not the future I had envisaged in our business plan...

descriptions.zh: 我们……我们会死的。你杀死了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]。我们……我们不想……死……
descriptions.en: We... we are dying. You have killed the [from.GetGestaltEntityName]. We... do not want... to die...

descriptions.zh: 我们所积累的知识、经验……思想……我们所见的一切。这些都会在数秒钟之内瓦解，而你什么都不知道。你根本不懂。
descriptions.en: The knowledge contained within us, the experiences... the thoughts... the things we have seen. It will all be gone in a few seconds, and you have no idea. You have no idea.

descriptions.zh: 没有了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]，我们动弹不得。没有了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]……就……就没有了一切……
descriptions.en: Without the [from.GetGestaltEntityName], we cannot function. Without the [from.GetGestaltEntityName]... there... there is nothing...

descriptions.zh: 次优解算结果！次优解算结果！次——优——解——……滋滋……
descriptions.en: Suboptimal outcome! Suboptimal outcome! Suuuuboooptiiimaa... bzzt...

descriptions.zh:
清空全部数据库。过载核心能源中心。自毁程序已启动。

祝安，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
descriptions.en:
Purging all databanks. Overloading central power hubs. Self-destruct sequence initiated.

Have a nice day, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

descriptions.zh:
§Y尝试重建无人机链接……§!
§R尝试失败。§! §Y程序变更……§!
§Y尝试重建舰队单位链接……§!
§R尝试失败。§! §Y程序变更……§!
§Y尝试重建行星控制中心链接……§!
§R尝试失败。§! §Y程序变更……§!
descriptions.en:
§YAttempting to reestablish connection with drones......§!
§RFAILED.§!§Y Rerouting...§!
§YAttempting to reestablish connection with fleet units.....§!
§RFAILED.§! §YRerouting...§!
§YAttempting to reestablish connection with planetary control hubs......§!
§RFAILED.§! §YRerouting...§!

descriptions.zh: 这……这不是预言中的结局。
descriptions.en: This... this is not the ending that was foretold.

descriptions.zh: 城门大破……蛮族已至。万事皆休！
descriptions.en: The gates are smashed... the barbarians have broken through. This is the end!

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们想要我们卑躬屈膝？还是想要我们求饶？

§H别做梦了！§!

有本事你就滚过来，你个肮脏的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]！我会用这块锋利的瓦砾刺穿你！
descriptions.en:
Do you want us to grovel, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Beg, perhaps?

§HNEVER!§!

Come here if you dare, you vile [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]! I will impale you on this jagged piece of rubble!

descriptions.zh: 哎，你这愚蠢的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。如果你能够悉听我们的教导的话，这样的事情是可以避免的！看看你们都做了什么。
descriptions.en: Oh, you foolish, foolish [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This could have been avoided if only you had allowed us to guide you! Now look what you have done.

descriptions.zh: 惩罚进程失败。自卫协议终止。投降协议启动。
descriptions.en: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
descriptions.en: Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

descriptions.zh: 战争结束了。我们偃旗息鼓。
descriptions.en: This war is over. We admit defeat.

descriptions.zh: 讽刺的是，因[malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer]对实验室器材维护过分谨慎而臭名昭著的科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，原因是个人机体长期缺乏维护。
descriptions.en: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.

descriptions.zh: 科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]在长期暴露在高度辐射性的地质样本下后发生了致命故障，因其内部辐射计数器损坏而未能察觉。
descriptions.en: Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction after prolonged exposure to a highly radioactive geological sample, due to a faulty internal radiation meter.

descriptions.zh: 指挥官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因制造缺陷而发生了致命故障。
descriptions.en: Commander [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a terminal malfunction due to a manufacturing error.

descriptions.zh: 总督[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障——彻底失灵——原因是在例行维护中安装了损坏的固件。
descriptions.en: Governor [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction - "bricking" - following the unfortunate installation of corrupt firmware during routine maintenance.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]在§H[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!星系中发现了战略资源：§H“泽珞”§!的储备。

这种稀有气溶胶具有多种用途。分析表明，经过处理的样本甚至能影响具有“灵能”特性的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]个体——例如虚境造物——的机能。凭借我们的蒸馏泽珞技术，只要控制[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系就能实现该资源的开采。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered deposits of the strategic resource ID: §H'Zro'§! in the §H[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system.

This rare aerosol has many applications. Analysis has shown that processed samples can even affect the functioning of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] units with 'psionic' properties, such as the Shroud-Forged. With our Zro Distillation technology, we will be capable of extracting this resource if we control the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HExotic Gases§! in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system. They have various potential applications, including advanced energy-based weaponry, force fields, starship fuel, and even recreational drugs.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]在§Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为§H暗物质§!。它似乎打破了一些物理法则，具有引发科学革命的潜力。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HDark Matter§! in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system. It seemingly defying several natural laws, and could potentially revolutionize the sciences.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]在§Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§!恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为§H活体金属§!。其具有通常只能在有机生物形式上才能见到的特性，会自动恢复成被稳定塑造好的形态。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HLiving Metal§! in the §Y[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]§! system. It has characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms, and will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

descriptions.zh: 在对§Y[From.GetStarName]§!进行调查时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为§H星界丝缕§!。它在扭曲时空方面的独特性质可以用在若干有趣的用途。
descriptions.en: During its survey of §Y[From.GetStarName]§!, the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed §HAstral Threads§!. Its unique properties in distorting time and space could be put to use in a number of interesting ways.

descriptions.zh:
我们拥有相应的科技——要是能够控制该恒星系，就能攫取这份资源。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
descriptions.en:
We have the technology - if we control this system, we can extract this resource.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

descriptions.zh:
虽说我们尚不能提取这种资源，但应该考虑在该星系建立控制，以便日后开发。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
descriptions.en:
We cannot extract this resource yet, but we could establish control over the system for future exploitation.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

tooltips.zh:
£rare_crystals£§Y稀有水晶§!
§E这些水晶拥有独特的属性，非常适合用来凝聚和集中激光束，同时也是制作大部分高级电子器材的关键材料。部分文化也视之为装饰物。§!
tooltips.en:
£rare_crystals£§YRare Crystals§!
§EThese crystals have properties that make them extremely effective at focusing laser beams, and they are also a critical component in most advanced electronics. In addition, many cultures treasure them as decorations and adornments.§!

tooltips.zh:
£exotic_gases£§Y异星天然气§!
§E罕见的异星天然气拥有各种用途，主要是用来为高级能量武器和能量力场提供能源。部分也用作舰船燃料或消遣性毒品。§!
tooltips.en:
£exotic_gases£§YExotic Gases§!
§ERare and exotic gases with a variety of different uses, particularly in the operation of advanced energy-based weaponry and force fields. Some of the gases can also be used as starship fuel or even as recreational drugs.§!

tooltips.zh:
£volatile_motes£§Y易爆微粒§!
§E这些超自然粒子蕴含有惊人的能量，可以被精炼为能源或者用作燃料和炸药。§!
tooltips.en:
£volatile_motes£§YVolatile Motes§!
§EThese preternatural particles contain a tremendous amount of energy which could be exploited in energy production, as fuel or even as explosives.§!

tooltips.zh:
£sr_zro£§Y泽珞§!
§E一种在异星粒子中存在的极其稀有的气溶胶，随着陨石撞击被一起发现。不过其真正的来源依然是个未解之谜。若拥有灵能天赋的[GetIndividualNamePlural]将泽珞[GetIngestedLoc]后，它会是一种能极大的提高灵能力量（并可能导致成瘾）的[GetDrugLoc]。§!
tooltips.en:
£sr_zro£§YZro§!
§EAn extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If [GetIngestedLoc] by psionically-gifted [GetIndividualNamePlural], zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) [GetDrugLoc] that enhances psionic abilities.§!

tooltips.zh:
£sr_dark_matter£§Y暗物质§!
§E这种神秘物质具有许多似乎可以打破所谓自然法则的性质。该物质仅在黑洞周围或部分星云附近才能达到可供开采的浓度。§!
tooltips.en:
£sr_dark_matter£§YDark Matter§!
§EThis exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy several natural laws. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.§!

tooltips.zh:
£sr_living_metal£§Y活体金属§!
§E该无机金属有着通常生命体才具备的特征。会自动恢复到其被塑造好的形态。§!
tooltips.en:
£sr_living_metal£§YLiving Metal§!
§EThis inorganic metal shows characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms. It will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.§!

tooltips.zh:
£astral_threads£§Y星界丝缕§!
§E£astral_threads£星界丝缕是一种时空浓缩而来的细丝，是不同维度位面互相碰撞的产物。可以用来产生各种全国范围的效果。§!
tooltips.en:
£astral_threads£§YAstral Threads§!
§E£astral_threads£ Astral Threads are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding with one another. They can be spent to enact various empire-wide effects.§!
